final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.timespan), total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS n FROM grouped), shares AS (SELECT g.timespan, g.order_count, CAST(g.order_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.n, 0) AS share FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_value FROM shares), above_mean AS (SELECT s.order_count, s.share, s.share - m.mean_value AS excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.mean_value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.mean_value) SELECT SUM(order_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_mean
